description.value: Inn at the Quay is a 13-storey waterfront hotel perched over the Fraser River in New Westminster, offering private balconied rooms with unobstructed river views and direct access to the boardwalk along the river. The hotel sits immediately next to the RiverMarket at Westminster Quay and is a short walk from a SkyTrain station, making it a practical base for exploring Greater Vancouver by transit or bike. Pet-friendly rooms and fully accessible ADA rooms with roll-in showers are available.

address.value: 900 Quayside Drive, New Westminster, BC V3M 6G1

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 69m; stands at 75m.
